title: KBR pseudo-OOS variable-selection pilot on current monthly data
key_result: Strict pilot gate found no single lagged macro/component indicator that robustly beats AR benchmark; best near-misses were d_Ki/spread for h=1, Ki/spread/USD for h=2, and Prod/spread/Serv/Ruonia for h=12.

title: Weekly Laspeyres nowcast prototype for June 2026
key_result: Prototype matched about 35% of CPI weight and finds June weekly pressure from matched items around +0.58 to +0.61 p.p.; gasoline is the dominant upward driver. Component-scaled signal is likely too high because matched non-food basket is gasoline-heavy.
